# Vendored `@vercel/sandbox` 3.1.0

npm pack of the published SDK (Apache-2.0). The package ships **compiled `dist/` only** — there is no TypeScript source in the tarball.

Used as the whitebox anchor for remaining Vercel Sandbox hunt work. See [whitebox-hypotheses.md](../../whitebox-hypotheses.md).

Upstream: https://github.com/vercel/sandbox (`packages/vercel-sandbox`).
Do not report client-only bugs; use this to reach server-honored dialects.
